items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Tuesday October 6th, 2026 at 8 pm (12 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Ottawa Side Events Series This competition is in a series with [Ottawa Side Events B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaSideEventsB2026). You will only be able to compete in one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le mardi 6 octobre 2026 à 20h (12 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Série de Ottawa Side Events Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec [Ottawa Side Events B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaSideEventsB2026). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://youtu.be/LH3QG7krdgc?si=zHT9ze8Wlfopxkr2). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc?si=L4lK3I42zL1eMo9j). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAxMzQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--40242509a354c6b141f64e1d7a4984d080346b6f/BANNER.png) ## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español ## Bienvenido al Road to Nats Mérida 2026 **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **40 competidores** para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsMerida2026#78450-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla. * Si tiene dudas, puedes contactar al equipo organizador. #### 📸 Aviso de Filmación Al asistir a **Road to Nats Mérida 2026**, autorizas a la organización a tomar fotografías y grabar videos durante el evento. Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Road to Nats Mérida 2026 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **40**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsMerida2026#78450-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) for you. It is very important to read it. * If you have any questions, you can contact the organizing team. #### 📸 Filming Notice By attending **Road to Nats Mérida 2026**, you authorize the organization to take photographs and record videos during the event. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. Your participation implies acceptance of this notice. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Nayarid Villarreal Ramírez Teléfono: 0424-7722293 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=584247722293&text=Hola!%20Quiero%20participar%20en%20la%20competencia%20Road%20to%20Nats%20M%C3%A9rida%202026%2C%20me%20puedes%20dar%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%3F%F0%9F%98%80) leidyvillarrealw@gmail.com

items.information: **Venha para um campeonato de dia único em um lindo local com infraestutura completa para passar o dia com a família em meio à natureza, pertinho da capital! ** O salão de eventos onde ocorrerá o campeonato fica em um complexo dentro de um parque ecológico privado com amplo estacionamento e com restaurante parceiro no local. Organizamos essa competição pensando no conforto dos competidores e acompanhantes. Queremos que todos sejam muito bem-vindos: em caso de dúvida, sintam-se livres para contatar no 51 99860 1894. local: https://www.instagram.com/complexoventonegroeventos buffet: https://www.instagram.com/refugiodosaborventonegro **Português** Valor de inscrição será de R$(25) a ser pago via pix para **(51998601894)** (enviar o comprovante para o e-mail luiz.m_k@hotmail.com ou para o whatsapp 5551998601894). Por favor, caso você se inscreva mas decida não ir ao campeonato, por favor nos informe para que possamos programar corretamente a quantidade de competidores. O competidor poderá se inscrever em quantas modalidades desejar. Pedimos que não se inscreva nas modalidades que não possui intenção de participar. É imprescindível ter lido as regras da WCA (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). O Buffet é livre no valor de R$(42), com desconto para confirmações até uma semana antes do evento (até dia 11) . O valor com desconto é de R$(38) e o pagamento segue as mesmas regras do pagamento da inscrição. **English** Registration fee is R$(25) and payment with PIX method, to the key **(51998601894)** (send the receipt to luiz.m_k@hotmail.com) . Please, if you register but decide not to come for the competition, please let us know so we can better figure out the number of competitor's to expect. The competitor can register for every event that he wants, we just ask to not register to events you're not certain at participating. Every competitor must have read WCA's Rules (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
